name: HR_Screening_Evaluation
description: Extract a structured, evidence-based evaluation from completed General HR Screening interviews.

communication.description: Score (1-10) for candidate's ability to explain ideas clearly and communicate coherently.

background_experience.description: Score (1-10) for how clearly the candidate explains educational background and experiences.

problem_solving.description: Score (1-10) for demonstrated problem identification, reasoning, decisions, and reflection.

teamwork.description: Score (1-10) for demonstrated collaboration, shared responsibility, and handling team situations.

self_awareness.description: Score (1-10) for candidate's ability to recognize strengths, development areas, and receive feedback.

adaptability.description: Score (1-10) for demonstrated learning, flexibility, and response to changing circumstances.

career_motivation.description: Score (1-10) for clarity, thoughtfulness, and realism of professional interests and goals.

interview_summary.description: Summarize the candidate's HR interview in 3-5 sentences.

key_strengths.description: Describe up to three strengths supported by the interview answers.

areas_for_improvement.description: Describe areas for development supported by evidence.

evaluation_reasoning.description: Explain the competency scores using specific candidate responses.

review_status.description: Return 'Ready for Human Review' or 'Insufficient Evidence'
